blocks.text: DNA har jaandaar cell ke nucleus mein hota hai. Yeh proteins banane ka coded plan, yani blueprint (naqsha), hai, aur proteins zindagi ke liye zaroori hain. Har khaas protein aik khaas gene se banta hai; gene DNA ka aik hissa (section) hai (Figure 27.14). Kisi jaandaar ki genetic information (maloomat) DNA molecules mein store hoti hai, jo tamam jaandaron ki development (nashonuma), functioning (kaam), growth (barhna) aur reproduction (nasal barhana) ki instructions (hidayaat) rakhte hain. DNA ki double helix structure apne chaar mukhtalif nitrogen wale bases ki sequence (tarteeb) ke zariye information store karti hai, aur proteins banane ke liye yeh information efficiently aur accurately (tezi aur theek tarah se) aage pohanchati hai.

Genes bari units mein organised (tarteeb se rakhe) hote hain jinhein chromosomes kehte hain; insaan ko parents (walidain) se chromosomes ke 23 pairs (jore) milte hain. Jism ke taqreeban har cell mein 23 pairs ka poora set hota hai, phir bhi har qism ka cell sirf apne kaam ke khaas genes chalu (switch on) karta hai. Maslan laal khoon ka cell haemoglobin ka gene chalu karta hai aur keratin ka gene band rakhta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab ka jumla 'each cell is a different specific pectine' chhapai mein bigra hua lagta hai. Is ka matlab yahi hai ke har cell sab genes nahi, balke apne kaam ke khaas genes istemal karta hai.

blocks.alt: Paanch jure circles (daire), har aik pichhle ka close-up: nucleus wala cell (genome, cell ke nucleus mein); chromosome (insaani cell mein 23 pairs); chromosome ka hissa jis mein aik gene marked hai (chromosome ka hissa jo aik protein banata hai); DNA double helix (sugar-phosphate chain se jure bases ki polymer chains); aur backbone par teen bases G, T, A (codon, teen bases ka group jo aik khaas amino acid ka code hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 27.14: DNA; genome se codon tak (kitab ki Figure 27.14 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: DNA ki structure aur function (banawat aur kaam)

1953 mein James Watson aur Francis Crick ne dikhaya ke DNA do polynucleotide chains se bana hai. Har chain right-handed (daen haath wala) helical spiral banati hai aur dono chains aik doosre ke gird lipat kar double helix banati hain. Dono chains aik jaisi nahi balke base pairing ki wajah se aik doosre ke opposite (ulat) hain, yani aik ka 3' end doosri ke 5' end ke saamne hota hai. Har chain ki sugar-phosphate backbone (main chain) hai jis se bases right angle (seedhe zaviye) par bahar nikalte hain aur doosri chain ke bases se kamzor hydrogen bonds se jure rehte hain. Adenine (A) hamesha thymine (T) ke saamne hota hai, aur guanine (G) cytosine (C) ke saamne. A aur T ke pair mein do hydrogen bonds aur G aur C ke pair mein teen hydrogen bonds hote hain (Figure 27.15).

blocks.alt: Baen, base pairing: do khari sugar-phosphate backbones ke darmiyan aath pairs (jore), A-T, C-G, G-C, G-C, T-A, T-A, C-G, G-C; A-T do tooti lakeeron (hydrogen bonds) se aur G-C teen se jure. Daen, double helix: do backbone ribbons (feete) aik doosre ke gird lipte, darmiyan rangeen base jore.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.15: DNA ki structure (kitab ki Figure 27.15 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Tooti lakeerein hydrogen bonds hain: A aur T ke darmiyan do, G aur C ke darmiyan teen. Base pairing wali seedhi seerhi hi mur kar double helix banti hai: dono kinare sugar-phosphate backbones hain aur darmiyan ki pattiyan base jore.

Genes DNA ke woh khaas hisse hain jo genetic information rakhte hain aur cell ko koi khaas protein banane ki instructions dete hain. DNA ka aik ahem process self-replication (apni copy khud banana) hai. Replication cell cycle ka woh process hai jis mein DNA copy hota hai, taa ke jab cell division (cell ka do mein batna) ho to har naye cell ko genetic material ka poora set mile. Is tarah genetic information aik cell se us ke daughter cells (naye bane cells) aur next generation (agli nasal) tak pohanchti hai.

blocks.prompt: A-T jore aur G-C jore ko kitne hydrogen bonds jorte hain?
blocks.explanation: A aur T ke darmiyan do; G aur C ke darmiyan teen.

items: DNA: do opposite (ulti) direction wali polynucleotide chains, daen haath ki double helix (Watson aur Crick, 1953).
A–T (2 hydrogen bonds), G–C (3 hydrogen bonds).
Genes proteins ka code hain; cell division se pehle DNA apni copy (replication) banata hai.
